capabilities.name: oa.business_trip.prepare
capabilities.description: Collect business-trip fields through a trusted card, validate the live OA form, and create a separate one-time confirmation card.

capabilities.name: oa.business_trip.save_draft
capabilities.description: Consume a trusted authorization once, save the frozen business-trip plan as an OA wait-send draft, and verify it by server readback.

capabilities.name: oa.business_trip.submit.prepare
capabilities.description: Collect business-trip fields through a trusted card, validate the live OA form and sent-item baseline, and create a separate submit authorization.

capabilities.name: oa.business_trip.submit
capabilities.description: Consume one trusted authorization, submit the frozen business-trip request, and verify one new readable item in the OA sent collection.

capabilities.name: oa.leave.prepare
capabilities.description: Collect supported leave-request fields through a trusted card, validate the live OA form, and create a separate draft-save authorization.

capabilities.name: oa.leave.save_draft
capabilities.description: Consume one trusted authorization, save the frozen leave request as an OA wait-send draft, and verify it by server readback without submission.

capabilities.name: oa.leave.submit.prepare
capabilities.description: Collect supported leave-request fields through a trusted card, validate the live OA form and sent-item baseline, and create a submit authorization.

capabilities.name: oa.leave.submit
capabilities.description: Consume one trusted authorization, submit the frozen leave request, and verify one new readable item in the OA sent collection.

capabilities.name: oa.missed_punch.prepare
capabilities.description: Collect missed-punch fields in a trusted card, validate the live OA form, and create a separate draft-save authorization.

capabilities.name: oa.missed_punch.save_draft
capabilities.description: Consume one trusted authorization, save the frozen missed-punch plan as an OA wait-send draft, and verify it without submitting approval.

capabilities.name: oa.missed_punch.approval.prepare
capabilities.description: Collect an approval opinion in a trusted card, validate one exact pending missed-punch item, and create a separate approval authorization.

capabilities.name: oa.missed_punch.approval.batch.prepare
capabilities.description: Compatibility entry; use oa.workflow.pending.batch.prepare for new batches. Freeze up to ten current pending missed-punch items and process them sequentially with independent trusted input and authorization.

capabilities.name: oa.workflow.pending.batch.prepare
capabilities.description: Freeze a variable-length selection of current OA pending items, including mixed supported workflow types. Process each with independent trusted input, authorization and verification. Use this for multiple/all pending items instead of promising to continue singular prepares. Incomplete sources, unsupported selections and overflow stop before any approval.

capabilities.name: oa.missed_punch.approve
capabilities.description: Consume one trusted authorization, approve the frozen missed-punch target, and verify that it left the pending collection.

capabilities.name: oa.meeting.create.prepare

capabilities.name: oa.meeting.create

capabilities.name: oa.meeting_room.application.prepare

capabilities.name: oa.meeting_room.application.create
capabilities.description: Consume trusted authorization, recheck availability, submit one standalone room application, and verify it in My Applications.

capabilities.name: oa.meeting_room.application.cancel.prepare
capabilities.description: Resolve one exact own standalone room application, collect a cancellation reason in a trusted card, and create separate cancellation authorization.

capabilities.name: oa.meeting_room.application.cancel
capabilities.description: Consume trusted authorization, cancel one exact own standalone room application, and verify its terminal readback.
